battleMedic.flavor: Battle Medic — {target} spends a d{faces} Hit Die
battleMedic.needTarget: Battle Medic: target the one creature you are tending first.
battleMedic.noHitDice: Battle Medic: {name} has no Hit Dice left to spend.
battleMedic.noGM: Battle Medic needs the GM online to heal a creature you don't control.
battleMedic.failed: Battle Medic was rolled, but {name}'s Hit Die and HP couldn't be updated — tell the GM.
battleMedic.done: {name} spends a d{faces} Hit Die and regains {healed} HP. Hit Dice left: {value}/{max}.
battleMedic.doneShort: {name} spends a d{faces} Hit Die and regains {healed} HP.

enabled.name: Feature riders
enabled.hint: Elemental Adept, Elemental Affinity, Potent Spellcasting, Healer and Battle Medic are applied automatically. Turn off to go back to doing them by hand.

hdControls.name: Hit Dice − / + on character sheets
hdControls.hint: Shows a − and a + beside Hit Dice on the character sheet outside edit mode, to spend or regain one Hit Die.

rituals.name: Ritual Adept rituals
rituals.hint: For a wizard with Ritual Adept: unprepared ritual spells get a 'Rituals' group on the Combat HUD's Cast Spell panel, and casting one starts with 'Consume Spell Slot' unticked (tick it to spend a slot anyway). Turn off to go back to Argon's prepared-only list and dnd5e's default.

concentrationSummons.name: Concentration summons leave with concentration
concentrationSummons.hint: When a caster's concentration ends (dropped, broken, or a new concentration spell), the tokens that spell summoned (Flaming Sphere, Summon Dragon...) are removed from the map by the GM's client; a summon that drops to 0 HP ends that concentration itself, with one whispered line. Summons without concentration are never touched. Turn off to clean them up by hand.

longCasts.name: Longer casts on the Combat HUD
longCasts.hint: Spells with a casting time of a minute or more (Animate Dead, Create Undead) are on none of the Combat HUD's bars. This adds a 'Longer casts' group to the Action bar's Cast Spell panel, for any character. Turn off to reach them from the sheet only.

concentrationAutoBreak.name: A failed concentration save ends concentration
concentrationAutoBreak.hint: When a concentration save fails, the concentration ends at once (and its summons with it), as the card's Break Concentration button would. Kept as a button when the creature could still turn the failure around (Legendary Resistance, Indomitable, a Mind Sharpener, Bardic Inspiration). The save card also shows the DC and whether it failed.

castDefaults.name: Summons start with Place Summons ticked
castDefaults.hint: A summon spell's dialog opens with 'Place Summons' ticked and its creature choice showing (Summon Undead and Animate Dead ship with it off); untick it to cast without placing. A self-only spell's card (Shield) also leaves out creatures you had targeted earlier.

arcaneRecovery.name: Arcane Recovery picks its slots
arcaneRecovery.hint: After a wizard uses Arcane Recovery, a small window shows their slots of level 1 to 5, how many are left of each, and a box per spent slot to tick; it opens with the highest ones that fit the PHB budget ticked (half the Wizard level, rounded up; +1 with an Arcane Grimoire). Recover restores them. A D&D Beyond import's own Arcane Recovery window is skipped while this is on. Turn off to restore slots on the sheet (or with the D&D Beyond macro) instead.

projectiles.name: One button per ray or dart
projectiles.hint: Scorching Ray and Magic Missile make several rolls, each at a creature of the caster's choice. Their chat card gets one button per ray or dart (3, plus one for each slot level above the spell's, or each extra wand charge), and nothing is rolled until you click one. Target a creature, then click the next button. Turn off to roll from the card's own button only (the first roll then comes up by itself after the cast).

spellView.name: Character sheets open on prepared spells
spellView.hint: The Spells tab shows the spells a character can cast today (prepared, always prepared, cantrips, at-will, innate, pact, cast from an item), with a Prepared / All spells switch above the list. Each user's choice is remembered per character. Turn off to always show the full list.

restCard.name: After a long rest: one card
restCard.hint: When a character finishes a long rest, its owner gets one whispered card with a line per thing the rest offers: Cosmic Omen (Read the stars: roll the day's omen, which marks Weal or Woe on the Combat HUD and the sheet until the next long rest) and, for a caster who prepares spells, Review prepared spells (opens the Spells tab on every spell). A Cosmic Omen used with no omen rolled yet rolls it then. Turn off for dnd5e's rest alone.

empoweredSpell.name: Empowered Spell: one click
empoweredSpell.hint: A sorcerer with Empowered Spell and Sorcery Points left gets an Empower (1 SP) button on their spell damage cards. One click spends the point, rerolls the dice that came up below their average (up to the Charisma modifier, lowest first) and posts the new damage roll; the old card's apply tray is retired so it cannot be applied twice. Shift-click picks the dice. Turn off to do Empowered Spell by hand.

projectileChatTab.name: Open Chat for ray and dart buttons
projectileChatTab.hint: This computer only. When you cast Scorching Ray or Magic Missile and the chat log is not showing, the sidebar opens on Chat so the card with the ray or dart buttons stays on screen (a chat pop-up card disappears after a few seconds). Turn off to keep the sidebar as it is.

summon.place: Click the map to place {name}. Right-click or Escape cancels.

arcaneRecovery.title: Arcane Recovery
arcaneRecovery.intro: Choose spent spell slots to recover: up to {cap} levels combined, none of level 6 or higher.
arcaneRecovery.open: Arcane Recovery: the slot picker is already open.
arcaneRecovery.done: {name} recovers spell slots by studying the spellbook: {slots}.
arcaneRecovery.none: Arcane Recovery: no spent slots of level 1 to 5 to recover.
arcaneRecovery.changed: Arcane Recovery: the spell slots changed while the window was open, so nothing was recovered.

ray.status: Scorching Ray at level {level}: {done} of {count} rays rolled. Target one creature, then click the next ray.
ray.oneTarget: Each ray strikes one creature: target just one, then click the ray.

dart.status: Magic Missile at level {level}: {done} of {count} darts rolled. Target one creature, then click the next dart.
dart.oneTarget: Each dart strikes one creature: target just one, then click the dart.

projectiles.noTarget: No creature targeted: the roll goes ahead untargeted.

spellView.label: Show
spellView.preparedTip: Spells you can cast today: prepared and always-prepared spells, cantrips, at-will, innate and pact spells, and spells cast from an item.
spellView.allTip: Every spell on this sheet, including the {n} you have not prepared. Prepare or unprepare them here.

usage.staleConcentration: Your concentration changed while this window was open, so nothing was cast. Close it and use the spell again to choose which concentration it ends.

omen.label: Cosmic Omen
omen.readTip: Roll the day's omen (1d6): even is Weal, odd is Woe, until your next long rest.
omen.redirect: You picked {clicked}, but the stars rolled {face}: {omen}.
omen.redirectStored: The stars read {omen} today: {activity} it is.
omen.gone: Cosmic Omen is no longer on the sheet.
omen.decidesLine: Read the stars (1d6): the die decides. Even is Weal, odd is Woe.

spells.label: Prepared spells
spells.reviewTip: Opens the Spells tab on every spell, so you can prepare and unprepare.

empower.tip: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll up to {n} damage dice that came up below their average; the new rolls are kept. Shift-click to choose the dice.
empower.title: Empowered Spell
empower.intro: Choose up to {n} dice to reroll (1 Sorcery Point). The new rolls are kept, higher or lower.
empower.superseded: Superseded by Empowered Spell: apply the new roll below.
empower.noUse: Empowered Spell was not used (no Sorcery Points left?). Nothing was rerolled.
empower.createFailed: Empowered Spell: the Sorcery Point was spent but the new damage card could not be posted. The old card stays live; tell the GM.
empower.retireFailed: Empowered Spell: the new damage card is posted, but the old card could not be marked as superseded. Apply only the new one.
empower.useCard: Use the Empower button on your spell's damage card: no Sorcery Point was spent.
